body:
> Named as a follow-up in the review of PR #147 (#146, merged): the worker reported the note arrived truncated, so it was never filed.

## Why

#146 made `hkbOnPath()` ignore npx's augmented `node_modules/.bin` and taught `installClaudeHooks` the `$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR` form. Two other writers still take `hkbCommandForHook()` / `hkbOnPath()` without a `root`: `installHarness` (`src/init.js`, `{{command}}` in `templates/codex/hooks.json` and `templates/copilot/…`) and `mcpLaunch` (`src/mcp.js`, `.mcp.json`). On a devDependency or self-checkout repo they now write `node "/abs/path/to/repo/node_modules/hkb-cli/bin/hkb.js"` (or `/abs/…/bin/hkb.js`) into **tracked** files — exactly what `docs/harnesses.md` says hkb never does, and wrong for every teammate.

## What

- Codex and Copilot have no `$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR`; check what each expands in a hook command (Codex runs hooks from the project root; Copilot's `.github/hooks/*.json` likewise) and use a cwd-relative `node node_modules/hkb-cli/bin/hkb.js` / `node bin/hkb.js` with the same `[ -f … ] || exit 0` guard where the harness runs a shell, or the plain relative form where it does not. Same `projectBinRel(root)` helper as #146 — one source of the remainder.
- `.mcp.json`: MCP servers launch from the project directory in Claude Code and VS Code; write `node` + the relative path there too, and say in the `hkb init --mcp` output which machines it resolves on.
- `hkb doctor`: the harness hook files and `.mcp.json` get the same resolve check `checkHooks` does for Claude's settings.
- `docs/harnesses.md` "where the hkb you ran init with lives" table gains the Codex/Copilot/MCP columns.

## Done when

- In a devDependency scratch repo, `npx hkb init --harness codex`, `--harness copilot` and `--mcp` write no absolute path anywhere (grep the generated files for `/home` or the tmp root), and each generated command runs from a plain `sh` in the project root with exit 0.
- Tests in `test/harness.test.js` for the three writers; `npm run lint && npm test` green; `npm run smoke` (init output changed).

## Contract

- Global-install repos keep the bare `hkb`; this is the third case only, as in #146.
goal: Every file hkb init writes for a devDependency or self-checkout install names hkb by a project-relative path, so the tracked Codex and Copilot hook files and .mcp.json mean the same thing on every machine
title: On a local-install repo, init still writes absolute machine paths into the Codex/Copilot hook files and .mcp.json
